cardEffects:
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash any 3 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, 1 of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text may unsuspend.
inheritedEffect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts would leave the battle area other than in battle, by suspending this Digimon, they don't leave.
name: Slayerdramon

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT20-027 (2025/01/24, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: Security] effects are activated first. Security] effects, if checked, will be activated immediately without pending activation. Other triggered effects are activated from the turn player's side.
rulings.question: If the [Security] effect, the "when security is checked" effect, and the "when security is reduced" effect are triggered simultaneously, in which order do they activate?

rulings.answer: One Digimon with the text "DRACOMON" or one Digimon with the text "EXAMON".
rulings.question: Which card can be activated by this card's [All Turns] effect?

rulings.answer: It refers to cards with the specified word or icon included in "name, trait, effect, inherited effect, <Overflow X>, jogress, digivolution requirements, burst digivolution". For example, a card with the text "Knightmon" refers to a card whose name is "Dark Knightmon" or whose effect says "Knightmon".
rulings.question: What do you mean by "cards with text?"

rulings.answer: The cards are either "cards with the text 'DRACOMON'" or "cards with the text 'EXAMON'".
rulings.question: Which digivolution card's inherited effect is triggered when it leaves?

rulings.answer: Yes, all those Digimons will not leave. The digivolution card's inherited effect is an effect that affects the whole card, not just any card.
rulings.question: When several of my Digimon with the text "DRACOMON" or "EXAMON" leave the Battle Area at the same time outside of battle, if I activate the digivolved effect of this card, will all of those Digimon not leave?
